figurative_meaning_en: Not keeping one's promise or word
example_sentences_in_english: He went back on his given word.
One should never break their promise.
history: Related proverb: কথা টলা থেকে পা টলা ভালো (Better to have unsteady feet than unsteady words).
note: This idiom emphasizes the cultural value of trustworthiness in Bengali society.
